article.headline: Tornadoes strike Delaware and New Jersey as snow chances arrive Friday morning
article.summary: Tornadoes touched down in New Castle County and Burlington County on Thursday, Nov. 12, following severe storms across the Philadelphia region.
article.body:
Hail accumulated in piles across the Pennsylvania suburbs on Thursday as severe storms brought heavy wind and an isolated tornado threat to the area. Meteorologist Brittney Shipp of NBC10 reported that the storms moved through the Philadelphia region bringing intense weather conditions before shifting toward the possibility of snow. Residents across the area faced fallen trees and funnel clouds throughout the day as the weather front progressed.

This weather pattern carries significant impacts for regional travel and property safety as cleanup efforts begin. The combination of storm damage and impending winter weather conditions on Friday requires residents to exercise caution during cleanup operations and morning commutes.

The National Weather Service confirmed that tornadoes struck both New Castle County, Delaware, and Burlington County, New Jersey. According to 6abc, officials have planned survey missions for Friday to assess the extent of the damage in the towns of Chesterfield and Bordentown. A preliminary survey attempted on Thursday evening was halted due to limited visibility from darkness. Crews are expected to coordinate further inspections to categorize the strength and duration of the storm activity that impacted these neighborhoods.

Survey crews will head to impacted areas on Friday to document the full scope of the tornado touchdown sites. These findings will help officials determine the specific wind speeds and structural impact caused by the severe weather system as the region prepares for the potential arrival of snow.

article.headline: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Replacing 3.8 Flash With Triple Speed
article.summary: Google has officially released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, more efficient AI model replacing the 3.8 Flash version across its products.
article.body:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen has arrived, boasting performance that triples the Terminal-Bench scores of its predecessor, the 3.8 Flash, while cutting fabricated claims by more than 5x. According to Google, the model is designed to deliver speed and intelligence for daily coding and agentic workflows, operating across four distinct thinking levels ranging from low to the new xhigh setting. 

For professional teams, the shift to Hydrogen represents a shift toward higher efficiency in software development. While models like Carbon and Argon remain the go-to for complex architectural tasks, Hydrogen serves as a high-speed execution engine for generating simpler code, running tests, and verifying changes. By utilizing the new Orchestrator feature in Google Antigravity, teams can dynamically switch between models, an approach that completed tasks 19% faster and consumed 24% less quota during testing on Terminal-Bench 4.0.

Google reports that Hydrogen is priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Its integration extends beyond development tools, reaching Google Search to handle complex, multipart questions with improved AI-powered Overviews and AI Mode. Unlike previous releases that prioritized staggered, security-conscious rollouts, Google has made Hydrogen immediately available to users across its ecosystem.

This release marks a significant departure from the previous Flash model, with Google positioning Hydrogen as the standard for everyday work. Looking ahead, developers are expected to utilize Hydrogen as part of multi-model workflows, where it functions alongside more powerful models to manage parallel agent tasks in isolated workspaces.

article.headline: Matt Henry’s triple-wicket maiden sparks New Zealand’s massive 244-run rout of India
article.summary: Matt Henry took 6-27 to bowl India out for 89 after Will Young’s 125 propelled New Zealand to a 333-run total at Bay Oval.
article.body:
Matt Henry dismantled India’s top order with a triple-wicket maiden in the opening over, setting the tone for a decisive 244-run victory at Bay Oval. India’s star batters Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli departed for zero as Henry claimed three wickets before a single run was scored, ultimately finishing with a devastating 6-27. The performance effectively halted India’s momentum in the best-of-five series and gave the home crowd of thousands a spectacle to witness in the final match of the tour at this venue.

This result keeps New Zealand’s hopes alive for a series draw after previously trailing 2-0. Protecting a six-year home ODI unbeaten run, the Black Caps delivered their most complete performance of the tour, capitalizing on batting conditions that allowed Will Young to hammer a career-best 125. The win provides a critical boost for the hosts as they look to secure a series-saving result on Sunday.

According to Cricbuzz and the NZ Herald, New Zealand posted 333, supported by Tim Seifert’s 58 off 48 balls and Finn Allen’s 41. India struggled from the start, with Shreyas Iyer trapped in front and the side dismissed inside 27 overs. While Kyle Jamieson and Matthew Fisher added to the pressure with steep bounce, Henry remained the chief destroyer, returning to clean up the tail and secure his fourth ODI five-wicket haul. 

New Zealand must now prepare for the series finale on Sunday without Matt Henry, who departs to join the Test squad in Wellington. The team aims to replicate this momentum at the Basin Reserve in the upcoming test series.

article.headline: London Firms Charge £100,000 for Fraudulent UK Global Talent Visa Packages
article.summary: An undercover BBC investigation revealed consultancy firms are creating fake art portfolios and fabricated credentials to help wealthy migrants secure UK visas.
article.body:
Wealthy migrants are paying over £100,000 for a "fully inclusive" package that guarantees a Global Talent visa, with consultants offering to supply artwork produced in China, arrange fake media coverage, and even hire individuals to pose as the applicant at gallery events. One consultant in London claimed no client utilizing this high-cost service had ever been refused entry under the fast-track scheme, which allows applicants to bring their families and achieve permanent residency in as little as three years. The investigation identified that agencies are planting fake articles on news websites using the bylines of reputable journalists to deceive immigration officials.

This exploitation of the Global Talent visa system poses significant security and integrity risks for the Home Office, which designed the program in 2020 to attract the world's most promising scientists, researchers, and artists. By bypassing rigorous interviews, the system relies on documentation that investigators found is now being systematically fabricated, including forged mentoring awards and evidence of non-existent speaking engagements for tech-track applicants.

Following the BBC's undercover findings, the Home Office has begun revoking the visas of two Nigerian men who successfully posed as fine art photographers using deceptive materials. Officials have labeled the revelations as "extremely serious" and confirmed that iCareer Consultancy UK, the firm identified as offering the £100,000 package, is currently under active investigation. 

While iCareer has denied selling visa services and claimed the consultant involved had left its employment, the investigation highlights a sophisticated network targeting wealthy nationals with promises of residency that require no English proficiency. The Home Office maintains it will not tolerate attempts to cheat the immigration system and continues to review the applications processed through these fraudulent channels.

article.summary: Washington Commanders practice squad quarterback Sam Hartman will star in the 30th season of ABC's The Bachelor, premiering on March 21, 2027.
article.body:
Sam Hartman is preparing for a transition that requires balancing football playbooks with romantic expectations. As he steps into his role as the lead for the milestone 30th season of The Bachelor, the 27-year-old quarterback faces the task of managing conversations with 30 contestants simultaneously. In his first interview about the casting, Hartman admitted he feels excited but very nervous about the upcoming process.

For viewers, this marks a crossover between professional sports and reality television, a format previously explored by former NFL quarterback Jesse Palmer in 2004. While participants often seek long-term relationships, the history of the franchise shows varied results, with over 20 couples from the series currently remaining together. Hartman becomes the second NFL signal-caller to headline the dating show in its two-decade history.

Hartman signed with the Washington Commanders as an undrafted free agent in 2024 following a collegiate career that saw him set several records. He played four seasons at Wake Forest University, where he received the Brian Piccolo Award after overcoming a rare blood clot condition, before transferring to the University of Notre Dame for his final season in 2023. During his time at Wake Forest, he finished with 134 touchdown passes, setting an Atlantic Coast Conference record. 

Fans can watch the season premiere of The Bachelor on Sunday, March 21, at 8 p.m. ET on ABC. The episodes will be available to stream on Hulu the day after the broadcast.

article.headline: Matt Henry rips through India with six wickets in massive 244-run win
article.summary: Matt Henry claimed six wickets to bowl India out for 89, securing a 244-run victory for New Zealand in the fourth ODI on Friday.
article.body:
The visitors were left reeling at 0-3 after the very first over of the chase, as Matt Henry dismissed Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shreyas Iyer in a devastating opening spell. India never recovered, falling to their sixth-lowest ODI total of just 89 runs at Mount Maunganui. This performance kept the series alive for the Black Caps, who now trail 2-1 heading into the final match. 

For New Zealand, the dominant victory provides a crucial boost after earlier struggles in the series. While the team can no longer win the five-match series, the 244-run margin highlights a clinical turnaround from the hosts. With India resting key players including captain Shubman Gill and KL Rahul for the upcoming test matches, the final ODI on Sunday offers New Zealand a chance to draw the series level.

According to RNZ, Matt Henry's clinical display with the ball was matched by a commanding batting performance from Will Young. After being dropped twice in the second over, Young capitalized to score 125 from 108 balls, marking his fifth ODI century and his highest score in the format. article.headline: Global Microsoft Outage Disables Outlook and Teams Across 74 Different Countries
article.summary: Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams faced a global disruption impacting users in 74 countries for over 12 hours starting Thursday.
article.body:
At least 43,000 users logged reports on the outage tracker Downdetector by 07:00 GMT on Friday, a figure that represents only a portion of those unable to access their workplace tools. The widespread disruption saw servers unexpectedly become unavailable, forcing Microsoft to attempt infrastructure reboots while battling ongoing connectivity errors that dragged through the US working day and into the night across Europe.

For millions of users, the outage means a total loss of access to essential communication and productivity software, including Outlook emails and the Teams collaboration platform. The instability persists even as the company applies patches, with some previously restored servers failing again, causing significant operational delays for businesses and individuals relying on these core cloud services.

According to Al Jazeera, the technical failure began at approximately 16:00 GMT on Thursday. Microsoft initially identified issues specific to the Americas but quickly expanded the scope to confirm that users in any region could be impacted by the elevated load on their infrastructure. The company explicitly noted that the connectivity errors were not triggered by a sudden surge in user traffic, but rather by internal server management issues.

Microsoft continues to monitor server performance across all affected regions as they work toward a full recovery. The company has publicly reported only marginal success in restoring services, emphasizing that technical teams are currently reviewing server performance to confirm that patches function as intended following the completion of full infrastructure reboots.

Czech captain Ladislav Krejci was initially cautioned with a yellow card for a professional foul on Roberto Fernandez, but the official upgraded the punishment to a red card after reviewing the footage. This forced the home team to finish the match with only 10 players, providing Spain with the tactical advantage needed to secure the late second goal.

article.summary: France fields star scrumhalf Antoine Dupont at flyhalf for Friday's Nations Championship match against South Africa at the Stade de France.
article.body:
Antoine Dupont shifting to the No 10 jersey marks a tactical pivot as France searches for an "unimaginable and unexpected" approach to challenge the world champions in Paris. The selection follows a period where France coach Fabien Galthié faced a shortage of traditional flyhalf options due to the injuries of Romain Ntamack, Matthieu Jalibert, and Antoine Hastoy.

This position adjustment is significant because the Springboks have historically dominated this fixture, winning nine of their past 10 Tests against France. For the visitors, controlling the set-piece remains the primary objective. According to former Springbok prop BJ Botha, South Africa possesses a massive depth advantage in the front row that will likely allow them to dictate terms in the scrum and maul battles at the Stade de France.

Springbok coach Rassie Erasmus noted earlier this week that he anticipated France would prioritize physicality in the flyhalf channel to avoid defensive gaps. While Galthié previously utilized Maxime Lucu at flyhalf during their recent 54-17 victory over Fiji, the decision to start Dupont indicates a shift in strategy. Erasmus remains confident that the match will evolve into a physical struggle for dominance between the two packs.

As the world champions prepare for the second Test of their tour, the pressure is on the French to disrupt a South African team that has won their past five encounters at this venue. Fans will see if Dupont’s creative presence can bridge the gap against a pack that features options like Wilco Louw, Thomas du Toit, and Ox Nché.
